Analysis tables for the assembly-based resistome.

* `arg_contigs.tsv`: one row per ARG-carrying contig (number of distinct ARGs, multi-ARG flag, WHO critical genes,
  mobility, host taxonomy).
* `arg_sample_summary.tsv`: one row per sample (counts and proportions) with metadata and diet scores.

Definitions

* **Multi-ARG contig**: contig carrying ≥ 2 distinct ARGs.
* **Critical ARG**: variant classified as Human use only, HPCIA or CIA in the WHO MIA List 2024
  (`Data/Processed/arg_who_classification.tsv`); **highest priority**: Human use only or HPCIA.
* **Mobile** (`has_mobile_element`, the broad flag): contig with any MAP annotation, structural evidence (repeats,
  compositional outliers) included. Script 05 builds the strict flag (`mobile_strict`: plasmid, insertion sequence,
  ICE/IME, prophage or viral sequence). **Plasmid**: geNomad plasmid call on a contig ≥ 5 kb; every plasmid call in
  these data is on a contig of at least 5,014 bp, so the length rule removes none. These are annotations of the
  contig; they do not show that the ARG is mobilised or transferred.

Assembly statistics and contig coverage come from `Data/Scripts/07.Assembly_stats.Rmd`.

* **Coverage-weighted abundance** of a set of contigs = Σ(coverage × length) of those contigs / Σ(coverage × length)
  of the whole assembly × 1e6, i.e. per million coverage-weighted assembled bases (the assembly equivalent of CPM).
* **ARG hits** = ARG occurrences on contigs; the MAMI breastfeeding study (Samarra et al., Nat Commun 2025) calls
  these "copies of ARGs". `cov_ARG_copies` sums the coverage of the contig of each hit, so
  `ARG_copies_per_Mb` = Σ(contig coverage over ARG hits) / coverage-weighted assembled Mb is a
  **coverage-weighted ARG density** (ARG hits per Mb of coverage-weighted assembly). It depends on assembly and
  coverage and is not an absolute number of gene copies. The column name is kept because other parts of the
  project read it.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

table_dir <- here("3.-Assembly_based", "Results", "Tables")
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


# Data load

```{r data load}
contig_master <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "contig_master.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
arg_who <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "arg_who_classification.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
metadata <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "metadata.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
diet_scores <- read_tsv(here("1.-FFQ_analysis", "Results", "Tables", "diet_scores.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
assembly_stats <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "assembly_stats.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
contig_coverage <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "contig_coverage.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```


# ARG hits

```{r hits}
arg_hits <- contig_master %>%
  left_join(arg_who %>% select(gene, who_category, who_classes, who_critical, who_highest_priority),
            by = c("AMR_variant" = "gene"))

stopifnot(!anyNA(arg_hits$who_category))
count(arg_hits, who_category)
```


# Contig table

```{r contigs}
arg_contigs <- arg_hits %>%
  group_by(sample_id, contig_id) %>%
  summarise(contig_length = first(contig_length),
            genus = first(genus),
            species = first(species),
            n_ARG_hits = n(),
            n_ARG = n_distinct(AMR_gene),
            ARG_combination = paste(sort(unique(AMR_gene)), collapse = " + "),
            n_critical_ARG = n_distinct(AMR_gene[who_critical]),
            critical_genes = paste(sort(unique(AMR_gene[who_critical])), collapse = " + "),
            highest_category = who_category[order(match(who_category, c("Human use only", "HPCIA", "CIA", "HIA", "IA",
                                                                        "Not medically important", "Unclassified")))][1],
            is_plasmid = any(is_plasmid),
            has_mobile_element = any(has_mobile_element),
            element_types = first(element_types),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(multi_ARG = n_ARG >= 2,
         has_critical = n_critical_ARG > 0,
         has_highest_priority = highest_category %in% c("Human use only", "HPCIA"),
         critical_genes = na_if(critical_genes, ""),
         log_contig_length = log(contig_length)) %>%
  left_join(contig_coverage %>% select(sample_id, contig_id, coverage), by = c("sample_id", "contig_id")) %>%
  mutate(coverage_bp = coverage * contig_length)

stopifnot(!anyNA(arg_contigs$coverage))

count(arg_contigs, n_ARG)
arg_contigs %>%
  group_by(multi_ARG) %>%
  summarise(contigs = n(), median_length = median(contig_length),
            critical = mean(has_critical), plasmid = mean(is_plasmid), mobile = mean(has_mobile_element),
            with_species = mean(!is.na(species)))
```


# Sample table

```{r samples}
arg_sample_summary <- arg_contigs %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  summarise(n_ARG_contigs = n(),
            n_multi_ARG_contigs = sum(multi_ARG),
            n_critical_contigs = sum(has_critical),
            n_multi_critical_contigs = sum(multi_ARG & has_critical),
            n_mobile_contigs = sum(has_mobile_element),
            ARG_contig_Mb = sum(contig_length) / 1e6,
            # Coverage-weighted bases of each contig set
            cov_ARG_contigs = sum(coverage_bp),
            cov_multi_ARG_contigs = sum(coverage_bp[multi_ARG]),
            cov_critical_contigs = sum(coverage_bp[has_critical]),
            cov_mobile_contigs = sum(coverage_bp[has_mobile_element]),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(arg_hits %>%
              left_join(contig_coverage %>% select(sample_id, contig_id, coverage), by = c("sample_id", "contig_id")) %>%
              group_by(sample_id) %>%
              summarise(n_ARG_hits = n(),
                        n_critical_hits = sum(who_critical),
                        n_highest_priority_hits = sum(who_highest_priority),
                        cov_ARG_copies = sum(coverage),
                        cov_critical_copies = sum(coverage[who_critical]),
                        .groups = "drop"),
            by = "sample_id") %>%
  right_join(metadata %>% transmute(sample_id, diet_group, sex, age, bmi, reads, log10_depth = log10(reads)),
             by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("n_"), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)),
         ARG_contig_Mb = replace_na(ARG_contig_Mb, 0),
         prop_multi_ARG = n_multi_ARG_contigs / n_ARG_contigs,
         prop_critical_contigs = n_critical_contigs / n_ARG_contigs,
         prop_mobile_contigs = n_mobile_contigs / n_ARG_contigs) %>%
  left_join(diet_scores, by = "sample_id") %>%
  left_join(assembly_stats, by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("cov_"), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)),
         # Abundance per million coverage-weighted assembled bases
         across(c(cov_ARG_contigs, cov_multi_ARG_contigs, cov_critical_contigs, cov_mobile_contigs),
                ~ .x / (coverage_weighted_Mb * 1e6) * 1e6, .names = "{str_replace(.col, 'cov_', 'abund_')}"),
         # Coverage-weighted ARG copies per coverage-weighted assembled Mb
         ARG_copies_per_Mb = cov_ARG_copies / coverage_weighted_Mb,
         critical_copies_per_Mb = cov_critical_copies / coverage_weighted_Mb)

stopifnot(!anyNA(arg_sample_summary$assembly_Mb))

cat("Samples:", nrow(arg_sample_summary), "| without ARG contigs:", sum(arg_sample_summary$n_ARG_contigs == 0), "\n")
```

```{r depth check}
# Counts depend on sequencing depth; proportions should not (Zaheer et al. 2018)
arg_sample_summary %>%
  summarise(across(c(n_ARG_contigs, n_multi_ARG_contigs, prop_multi_ARG, prop_critical_contigs,
                     abund_ARG_contigs, abund_multi_ARG_contigs, ARG_copies_per_Mb, assembly_Mb, N50),
                   ~ cor(.x, log10_depth, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "spearman_rho_with_depth")
```


# Save

```{r save}
write_tsv(arg_hits, file.path(table_dir, "arg_hits.tsv"))
write_tsv(arg_contigs, file.path(table_dir, "arg_contigs.tsv"))
write_tsv(arg_sample_summary, file.path(table_dir, "arg_sample_summary.tsv"))
```
